acceptance: Each SingleStore load path is listed, with the malformed-decimal result before the fix.
Each path aborts on a malformed decimal after the fix, shown by a live test under the live_singlestore marker.
Valid data loads unchanged (row counts and decimal sums on TPC-H SF0.01).
description:
Found while implementing SingleStore native RF1 ingest (#3979) on SingleStore 10.9.0 (dev image under mocker). With LOAD DATA, a non-numeric value in a DECIMAL column is stored as 0.00 even in strict mode. INT, DATE and CHAR-length errors are rejected. #3979 guards only the RF1 path, loading DECIMAL columns through @var with SET col = IF(@col REGEXP ..., @col, 1e30) so the server aborts. The bulk data load path (SingleStoreAdapter load_data / LOAD DATA for benchmark tables) and any other LOAD DATA use have not been checked. A malformed decimal in a data file would load as 0.00 and change query answers silently.

Change. Find every SingleStore LOAD DATA path. Prove the behaviour on each with a malformed-decimal file, and apply the same abort guard (or an equivalent the server honours) where needed.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; heavy work only through make heavy-run; container checks under mocker one stack at a time (limits in tests/uat docs and the uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context); no live cloud without owner approval; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing.
